name: Guitar2Tabs
install:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y python3.12-venv ffmpeg tor
npm ci
cp -n .env.example .env.local || true
cd python-backend && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-minimal.txt cachetools==5.5.1 aiofiles python-dotenv && grep -q 'YTDLP_USE_TOR=true' ../.env.local || printf '\nYTDLP_USE_TOR=true\nYTDLP_AUTO_TOR=true\nYTDLP_START_POT_PROVIDER=true\n' >> ../.env.local
